title: List the full names of members who attended social events and also incurred
question: List the full names of members who attended social events and also incurred expenses across more than one event, ordered by their total spending in descending order, limited to the top three spenders.

prediction.sql:
SELECT m."XCL_035", m."XCL_036"
FROM member AS m
WHERE m."XCL_034" IN (
    SELECT a."XCL_002"
    FROM attendance AS a
    INNER JOIN event AS ev ON a."XCL_001" = ev."XCL_010"
    WHERE ev."XCL_013" = 'Social'
)
AND m."XCL_034" IN (
    SELECT e."XCL_022"
    FROM expense AS e
    INNER JOIN budget AS b ON e."XCL_023" = b."XCL_003"
    INNER JOIN event AS ev2 ON b."XCL_009" = ev2."XCL_010"
    GROUP BY e."XCL_022"
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ev2."XCL_010") > 1
)
ORDER BY (
    SELECT SUM(e2."XCL_020")
    FROM expense AS e2
    WHERE e2."XCL_022" = m."XCL_034"
) DESC
LIMIT 3
